# HYPE

HYPE is a Cork creative agency making brand films, documentaries, social media and PR for hospitality, leisure, retail, food, drink and property brands across Ireland. Founded 2019.

## Contact
- Email: hello@hypedigital.ie
- Property content: property@hypedigital.ie
- Location: Cork, Ireland (service-area business, no public office)
- Every client message answered within 24 hours
